description: Covers B20, B21, B27, B30, B39. Race-free stale lock takeover in job.sh lock and the watcher's expiry (B20); a ps1 job's exit code from its last statement, not a stale $LASTEXITCODE (B21); the kill job returns only at not_running (B27); the prefs overlay sets every occurrence of a key or refuses a duplicated one (B30); pc_deploy.py set waits for, or refuses on, a pending profile restore (B39). Host tests first.
title: Watcher and pc_deploy race fixes
